title: Comparison mate for the integer endpoint maps
statement: For a morphism of schemes, the adjoint mates of the etale constant comparison, the pro-etale inverse-image comparison, and the direct-image comparison agree after the canonical site-comparison mate.

source.place: Paragraph (2), adjunction-mate calculation underlying the integer endpoint square

lean.statement: theorem integral_site_pullback_integer_endpoint_mate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) : let A := (constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) let B := (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) let AY := (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) let BX := (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv A B) ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))).hom ≫ (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).map ((comparisonAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).homEquiv B BX (integerComparison X).hom) ≫ (lowerStarCompComparisonLowerStarIso f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).symm.hom.app BX = (comparisonAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).homEquiv A AY (integerComparison Y).hom ≫ (comparisonLowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).map ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv AY BX (proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))))
